item.title: Noskova plans to 'get drunk and forget' after heartbreaking loss to Sabalenka
item.description: Linda Noskova plans to drown her sorrows and enjoy New York after the Wimbledon champion came agonisingly close to a stunning upset against world number one Aryna Sabalenka in the U.S. Open quarter-finals on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Janina Rios
item.content:encoded: Linda Noskova plans to drown her sorrows and enjoy New York after the Wimbledon champion came agonisingly close to a stunning upset against world number one Aryna Sabalenka in the U.S. Open quarter-finals on Tuesday. The Czech led by a break in the deciding set and held an advantage in the final tiebreak before eventually [USN:L6N450106 TEXT:"falling 7-6(1) 3-6 7-6(10-7)"] to the two-time defending champion in a gruelling three-hour battle at Arthur Ashe Stadium. Rather than mope about the defeat, the 21-year-old has decided to make the most of the Big Apple before heading home. "I'm going to stay for, like, three more days. I'm going to get drunk and forget about this, I guess," Noskova told reporters with a laugh. "I'm old enough to do that, thankfully." "I love New York. I have so many places I want to go. I have a lot of great friends here. They will show me around and, you know, I will forget about it hopefully in the next couple of hours." There was plenty worth forgetting after Noskova repeatedly pushed top seed Sabalenka to the limit, only to watch the Belarusian fight back in the third set and prevail in the tiebreak. Noskova admitted she could have made different decisions at crucial moments but said Sabalenka had produced her best tennis when it mattered. Still, the defeat served as a reminder of how far Noskova has come since her Wimbledon breakthrough. "I feel like I have that back," she said of her motivation after previously struggling to find her hunger following recent success. "Such loss is good for the motivation... I have to take some positives from it all." Despite the disappointment, Noskova feels she belongs among the WTA elite, having reached a career-high world number six last month. "After these matches when you're so close... it kind of reminds you of where you are standing," she said. "I will just try to keep going, you know. I feel great on court, which is always my main point, and ranking doesn't really matter."

item.title: Evommune scraps eczema drug after trial miss, shares plunge
item.description: Evommune said on Tuesday it will not advance its experimental skin disease drug after it failed to meet the main goal in a mid-stage trial, sending its shares down 24% in aftermarket trading.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Evommune (EVMN.N) said on Tuesday it will not advance its experimental skin disease drug after it failed to meet the main goal in a mid-stage trial, sending its shares down 24% in aftermarket trading. Here are some details The company said its drug, EVO756, did not show a meaningful percent change in a scale that measures the severity of eczema when tested in patients with atopic dermatitis. Atopic dermatitis is a chronic, inflammatory skin condition that causes dry, red, itchy and irritated patches of skin. The trial enrolled 121 adults with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis over a 12-week treatment period, with follow-up through week 14. Evommune said the drug did not meet the primary or secondary goals in any of the doses studied. The company said it will continue to develop EVO756 for migraine prevention. "EVO756 was generally well tolerated with a safety profile consistent with prior studies, supporting its continued evaluation in migraine prophylaxis," said Eugene Bauer, Chief Medical Officer. Evommune said its balance sheet is expected to fund operations through 2029, supporting the advancement of its portfolio of programs aimed at broadly addressing chronic inflammatory diseases.

item.title: Cerberus sells real estate firm Tenet Equity to CBRE for $1.6 billion
item.description: U.S. private equity firm Cerberus said on Tuesday it has sold Tenet Equity, a real estate finance company, to the asset management arm of real estate investment trust CBRE Group for $1.6 billion.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. private equity firm Cerberus said on Tuesday it has sold Tenet Equity, a real estate finance company, to the asset management arm of real estate investment trust CBRE Group (CBRE.N) for $1.6 billion. Cerberus founded Tenet in 2021 to provide real estate-backed funding to middle-market companies and private equity firms across the United States. Scottsdale, Arizona-based Tenet's portfolio currently includes more than 200 properties spanning 26 industries across 39 states. Its sale to CBRE Investment Management comes as investors favor long-term leased properties for their steady income, while companies turn to sale-leasebacks to raise capital amid higher borrowing costs. Evercore served as exclusive financial advisor to Cerberus for the sale. CBRE's shares were up 1.2% after the bell.

item.title: South Korea says Hormuz talks with France concern contribution options, not troop deployment
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and French President Emmanuel Macron discussed cooperation on security and freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz during a summit in Paris on Tuesday, but the talks did not concern troop deployment, Seoul's presidential office said.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and French President Emmanuel Macron discussed cooperation on security and freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz during a summit in Paris on Tuesday, but the talks did not concern troop deployment, Seoul's presidential office said. Lee, on a state visit to France, said at a joint press conference that he had discussed the Strait of Hormuz with Macron as part of wider talks on international security issues. "South Korea and France agreed to continue close coordination so that freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and the stability of global supply chains can be restored swiftly," Lee said. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical energy transit route for South Korea, which relied on the waterway for 61% of its crude oil imports and 54% of its naphtha imports last year. In a briefing after the summit, South Korean National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac said discussions focused on how South Korea could contribute to international efforts concerning maritime security in the strait rather than on troop deployment. "We are still in the review stage," Wi said, regarding Seoul's contribution options. "No decision has been made." Wi also said Iran had expressed interest and sought explanations through diplomatic channels following media reports about a possible South Korean role in Hormuz security efforts. He added that Seoul's review of Hormuz contribution options was unrelated to U.S. investment discussions, rejecting suggestions the two issues were linked. South Korea's defence ministry said earlier on Tuesday it had sent an [USN:L1N4500GF TEXT:"inspection team"] to the United Arab Emirates to assess security conditions in the region, but stressed that the mission was intended to gather information and did not presuppose a troop deployment. South Korea's presidential office separately said reports that the U.S. had set a deadline for Seoul to dispatch assets to Hormuz were untrue. Seoul said last week it was reviewing various options, including military measures, to contribute to freedom of navigation in Hormuz, while denying reports a deployment decision had already been made. The announcement followed U.S. President Donald Trump's [USN:L1N44D05G TEXT:"decision"] in August to scale back U.S.-South Korea joint military exercises, which he said was partly because South Korea had declined to assist Washington in the U.S.-Iran conflict. Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson warned this week that any South Korean military participation in operations in the Gulf or Strait of Hormuz would be regarded as support for U.S. "aggression" and would carry serious consequences.

item.title: BC anuncia leilão à vista de até US$1 bi e operação de swap reverso na 5ª-feira
item.description: O Banco Central anunciou na noite desta terça-feira, por meio de dois comunicados, a realização na quinta-feira de dois leilões simultâneos, das 9h20 às 9h25, no mercado de câmbio, sendo um de venda à vista de dólares e outro de swap cambial reverso.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Banco Central anunciou na noite desta terça-feira, por meio de dois comunicados, a realização na quinta-feira de dois leilões simultâneos, das 9h20 às 9h25, no mercado de câmbio, sendo um de venda à vista de dólares e outro de swap cambial reverso. Conforme o BC, no leilão à vista será ofertado US$1,0 bilhão. Nesta venda, na prática o BC retira dólares das reservas internacionais e vende aos dealers de câmbio. Já na operação de swap cambial reverso o BC negociará até 20.000 contratos, o que também equivale a US$1 bilhão. O efeito prático desta operação, porém, é equivalente a uma compra de dólares no mercado futuro. De acordo com o comunicado, na operação de swap reverso a data de início do contrato será sexta-feira, dia seguinte ao leilão, enquanto a data de vencimento será 1º de outubro deste ano. (Redação São Paulo) REUTERS AC IS

item.title: Aussie tycoon stands on precipice of M&A glory
item.description: Ryan Stokes nearly secured his deal-tactician legacy with an $11 bln joint bid for BlueScope Steel. It would have set a domestic record but was too opportunistic. The scion's wile and patience as CEO of conglomerate SGH suggests another bold acquisition will surface before long.
item.dc:creator: Antony Currie
item.content:encoded: Ryan Stokes is one big deal away from securing his place in the M&A firmament. The CEO of conglomerate SGH (SGH.AX) , and son of media mogul Kerry, tried to pull off Australia's biggest domestic corporate [USN:L6N3Y7067 TEXT:"takeover"], of BlueScope Steel (BSL.AX) . An uncharacteristic setback will probably only be temporary. As he reshapes the empire to better suit the modern world, others will be subjected to his patient and crafty tactics. Stokes is a child of the generation that designed the business landscape Down Under. In the late 1970s, his father started buying Seven television network franchises, including from one of the country's most accomplished tycoons, Rupert Murdoch. A few years later, the elder Stokes added a heavy-machinery franchise, now called WesTrac, that has become an integral part of the company. After turning 50 this year, Ryan looks well-positioned to carry on the acquisitive tradition. Although Kerry's maneuvering from Melbourne largely escaped the sort of scrutiny attracted by merger mavens such as Murdoch, Li Ka-shing, John Malone, Carlos Brito and Bernard Arnault, his son may yet command greater recognition for wheeling and dealing. Many CEOs are lucky to nail down one or two splashy mergers. In Australia, private equity firms like Brookfield now dominate, with corporate buyers like BHP (BHP.AX) accounting for only four of the top 20 buyers by volume since 2015, per data compiler Dealogic. Whatever follows, BlueScope will be pivotal. SGH, with U.S. partner Steel Dynamics (STLD.O) , valued the Aussie steelmaker at A$15 billion, or nearly $11 billion, but the board rejected their overtures. Although Stokes confirmed last month that the deal is on ice, he intends to expand SGH by capitalizing on a housing shortage and the AI data centre-fuelled construction bonanza. He emphasizes operational discipline to improve returns and cash flow at businesses he considers good fits under the A$16 billion SGH umbrella. In addition to WesTrac, the portfolio includes equipment-rental giant Coates; building-materials maker Boral; oil-and-gas driller SGH Energy; and a 30% stake in $2 billion Beach Energy (BPT.AX) . It also owns 20% of Southern Cross Media (SXL.AX) , the TV, radio and newspaper group where Stokes became chair on Monday, a role once held by his father. Investing in those units is the priority, but M&A is "a key pillar of our growth strategy" to increase operating profit 10% over time, Stokes told investors last month. The approach has served shareholders well. A $100 investment when Stokes became CEO in 2015 would be worth $947 today, including dividends, more than twice the return of the similarly sprawling Wesfarmers (WES.AX) and 12 times the broader market performance. Stokes was promoted to the top job the same year that SGH, then known as Seven Group Holdings, bought 20% stakes in Beach Energy and peer Drillsearch. Within months, the two companies merged. His perseverance soon became evident. Stokes made use of the so-called creep provision, which limits any investor with at least a 20% holding to buying no more than 3% extra every six months. The rule is designed to prevent an interloper from quickly taking control without paying a premium. In practice, it means a restrained shopper can slowly but steadily bulk up, often at a more reasonable price. SGH has held its Beach Energy stake steady at 30% since 2018. SGH also uses minority positions as beachheads. In 2017, for example, Stokes acquired the 53% of Coates his company didn't already own, from buyout shop Carlyle (CG.O) . He used a similar playbook in his pursuit of Boral, where his M&A capabilities gained broader notice. Stokes started buying shares in the cement and asphalt manufacturer in March 2020, growing the stake to 20% in six months. After SGH added another 3%, it unveiled a tender offer for the rest , valuing Boral's equity at A$8 billion. The board offered no premium and said it would be "satisfied" with increasing its holding to 30%. The gambit deprived the target's shareholders of any uplift on the stock price, but Stokes read the situation well: within weeks, his company owned 71% of Boral. Three years later, he mopped up the rest, securing cash flow that helped reduce SGH's net debt to 1.8 times EBITDA, below its stated cap. These past successes make the BlueScope situation all the more vexing. Stokes waited until he found a partner willing to absorb the larger U.S. business. With the 32% control premium they offered, BlueScope stock soared to a 17-year high. Moreover, SGH shareholders embraced the plan: the stock closed up nearly 4% on the day the deal news broke, even though the implied return on investment only worked out to about 6%, according to Breakingviews calculations, below SGH's stated 10% minimum target. Stokes evidently earned the benefit of the doubt: Boral's return on capital employed in the 12 months to the end of June was just shy of 20%, up considerably from 2021. In this case, however, Stokes and his U.S. counterpart were too clever by half. They pegged their offer to BlueScope's dismal performance in the previous financial year, even though analysts were already forecasting operating earnings would increase by more than 50%, per LSEG data. If anything, the bid helped illuminate the rebound. AustralianSuper, the country's largest pension fund, had built a 12% position in BlueScope in 2025 and said it would only consider a "materially higher" price, while it increased its stake to almost 14%. The fund's pressure evoked its successful campaign against another joint deal, [USN:L4N3D24GI TEXT:"Brookfield and EIG's"] offer to buy Origin Energy (ORG.AX) for $13 billion in 2023. BlueScope's second-largest shareholder with some 7%, L1 Capital, also wanted a higher offer. Combined, that emboldened the steelmaker's board to reject the overture. Since then, the company's shares have clung to their Stokes-induced gains, while SGH's have dropped by about a fifth, despite solid earnings disclosed last month. This disparity in valuations, and presumably some good financial sense, explains why SGH backed off. It also gives Stokes breathing room to assess what went wrong. There almost certainly will be a next time, whether it's BlueScope or another chunky industrial target subjected to his cagey deal tactics. The difficulty may be that his reputation now precedes him. Follow Antony Currie on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Southern Cross Media said on September 7 that board member and SGH CEO Ryan Stokes would become non-executive chair with immediate effect, replacing Teresa Dyson, who will become a non-executive director overseeing a newly established risk, regulatory and compliance committee. Cathy O'Connor was elected as lead independent director at the Australian media company, whose holdings include the Seven Network, the Triple M radio networks and The Sunday Times. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Los aranceles de Canadá en represalia contra EEUU entran en vigor con la negociación estancada
item.description: Los aranceles de represalia de Canadá a productos estadounidenses entraron en vigor la medianoche del martes, lo que intensifica una guerra comercial que ya dura 18 meses y llevó al primer ministro Mark Carney a instar a una mayor diversificación de las relaciones comerciales.
item.dc:creator: Promit Mukherjee
item.content:encoded: Los aranceles de represalia de Canadá a productos estadounidenses entraron en vigor la medianoche del martes, lo que intensifica una guerra comercial que ya dura 18 meses y llevó al primer ministro Mark Carney a instar a una mayor diversificación de las relaciones comerciales. Los aranceles de Ottawa son una respuesta a los aranceles del 50% que Estados Unidos impuso el mes pasado a unos 20.000 millones de dólares de productos canadienses, tras el fracaso de varias rondas de negociaciones. La ruptura ha agravado la brecha entre los antiguos aliados, que se han culpado mutuamente del fracaso de las negociaciones. "Tenemos todo lo necesario para dar un giro y prosperar", dijo Carney el martes en un vídeo publicado en YouTube tras la entrada en vigor de los aranceles. "Ese cambio tendrá un costo. La acción siempre conlleva un costo. Pero no se acerca ni de lejos al costo de no hacer nada", añadió. Ottawa diseñó las medidas de represalia para ejercer presión económica y política sobre Washington, dijeron funcionarios del Gobierno canadiense. Se espera que los aranceles afecten a sectores de algunos estados clave, como Míchigan y Ohio, antes de las elecciones legislativas de noviembre en Estados Unidos. Los aranceles de represalia de Ottawa afectan a unos 20.000 millones de dólares en productos estadounidenses, con tasas que oscilan entre el 15% y el 50% para productos que van desde el acero y los muebles hasta la ropa y la electrónica. Si bien los nuevos aranceles afectan a una pequeña parte de las exportaciones en comparación con el comercio total entre Estados Unidos y Canadá, a algunos analistas les preocupa que este enfrentamiento pueda desestabilizar el acuerdo entre de los tres socios de América del Norte, que suma a México. "Lo que nos preocupa es una espiral de escalada", dijo Michael Harvey, director ejecutivo de la Alianza Canadiense para el Comercio Agroalimentario y miembro del comité asesor de Carney sobre relaciones económicas bilaterales con Estados Unidos. "Pero, al mismo tiempo, entendemos perfectamente que el primer ministro necesita encontrar puntos de presión", añadió Harvey.

item.title: 英主要空港、大規模欠航・遅延が発生 管制サービス企業のシステム障害で
item.description:
Sam Tabahriti Joanna Plucinska
[ロンドン ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sam Tabahriti　Joanna Plucinska

[ロンドン ８日 ロイター] - 英国の主要空港で８日、航空管制サービス企業ＮＡＴＳのシステム障害により航空便の運航に大きな混乱が発生した。航空インフラの信頼性を巡る懸念が改めて浮上した形だ。

今回のトラブルでは数百便が欠航し、さらに数百便に遅延が発生した。ＮＡＴＳでは３年前にも飛行計画処理システムの障害でより大規模な混乱が発生しており、今回の事態を受けて同社に対する目がより厳しさを増している。

英国各地の空港では多くの利用者が出発ロビーで情報を待つ状況となり、航空各社からは英国の航空管制システムが現在の運航需要に対応できているのか疑問の声が上がった。

ＮＡＴＳは８日午後７時３４分（日本時間９日午前３時３４分）、飛行データ処理システムに影響を与えていた問題は解消されたと発表した。同社はこれに先立ち「安全性は損なわれていない」と説明していた。

Ｘに「本日のシステム障害からの復旧には想定以上の時間を要した。問題は現在解決しており、通常運用に戻っている。滞留した便の解消に全力を挙げている」とコメントした。

影響が及んだのは、英国最大の空港であるヒースロー空港を含め、発着便合わせて約１０００便。航空機追跡サイト「フライトアウェア」のデータに基づくと、日本時間９日午前０時１８分時点で、ヒースロー、ガトウィック、ロンドン・シティー、ルートン、エディンバラ、ブリストルの６空港で計約４９０便の出発便が遅延した。

また、これら６空港では到着便約５２５便が欠航または遅延となった。

航空分析会社シリウムによると、ヒースロー空港では予定されていた到着便６６１便のうち３８便が欠航、または運航不能となった。航空会社別ではブリティッシュ・エアウェイズが予定出発便３３３便のうち１６便を欠航し、最も大きな影響を受けた。

格安航空会社ライアンエアーは、６万５０００人超の利用者が最大８時間の遅延の影響を受け、５０便余りを欠航にしたと発表した上で、ＮＡＴＳのマーティン・ロルフ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任を求めた。

ライアンエアーのニール・マクマホン最高執行責任者（ＣＯＯ）は「利用者はあと何回システム障害に苦しめられればよいのか。高額報酬を受け取るＮＡＴＳのロルフＣＥＯは、度重なる経営失敗の責任を取り辞任すべきだ」と批判した。

格安航空会社ウィズエアーも、航空管制システムの抜本改革を要求。「航空会社、利用者、空港が繰り返されるシステム障害の代償を負い続けるべきではない。重要な国家インフラ事業者が繰り返し航空システム全体を停止状態に追い込むべきではない。現在のＮＡＴＳは本来求められる機能を果たしていない」と苦言を呈した。

英民間航空局（ＣＡＡ）は、今回の障害に関する詳細な報告書をＮＡＴＳに提出するよう求める方針を示した。ＣＡＡは報告内容を精査した上で、英国の航空管制システムの信頼性確保に向け、追加措置が必要かどうかを判断するとしている。

ＣＡＡは２０２４年、前年に発生した飛行計画の自動処理システム障害を受け、ＮＡＴＳに対し障害発生時の対応計画を見直すよう求めていた。航空各社の経営陣によると、この障害に伴う払い戻しや補償費用は総額１億ポンド（１億３５４９万ドル）を超えた。

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（8日）米国株続落、円一時152円台後半、利回りやや上昇
item.description: ＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が対ドルで７カ月ぶり高値付近で推移した。ドルは主要通貨に対して概ね横ばい。原...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（8日）米国株続落、円一時152円台後半、利回りやや上昇 6:54 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）の取引フロア。9月8日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が対ドルで７カ月ぶり高値付近で推移した。ドルは主要通貨に対して概ね横ばい。原油価格の再上昇と米国債利回りの上昇を受け、投資家は慎重姿勢を維持した。

日銀の利上げペース加速への期待や、日本の投資家による海外資金の還流（リパトリエーション）観測、キャリートレードの巻き戻しなどを背景に、円は先週以降、約５％上昇している。アジア時間の取引で、円は一時１ドル＝１５２．８９円まで上昇し、日本政府・日銀が７月に実施した円買い介入時の水準を上回り、２月以来の高値を付けた。その後は上げ幅を縮小し、直近では０．０３％高の１５３．８１円で推移している。

バノックバーン・グローバル・フォレックスのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「先週見られた強力なショートスクイーズが継続しているようだ」と指摘。「今のところ、政府による介入の兆候はほとんど見られない。円がキャリートレードの調達通貨として使われてきた中で、市場の調整という側面が強いようだ」とし、「その大幅な巻き戻しが起きている」と述べた。

片山さつき財務相は８日の閣議後会見で、為替対応を巡り「秩序ある為替相場の維持に努めていく」と述べた。７月末の日米協調介入以降、「われわれの対応方針は一切変わっていない」との考えも示した。

ユーロは対円で１ユーロ＝１７８．８３円と、９カ月ぶり安値付近で推移した。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 米金融・債券市場では、国債利回りがやや上昇した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が来週の会合で利上げに踏み切るか見極めようと、週内に発表される物価指標が注目されている。原油価格が約６週間ぶりの高値を付けたことも利回り上昇の要因になった。

ＦＲＢが１５－１６日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を巡っては、労働省が４日に発表した８月の雇用統計で非農業部門雇用者数の増加が市場予想を大幅に上回ったことを受け、利上げ観測が強まった。今週の注目は１０日発表の８月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）と１１日発表の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）。ＦＨＮフィナンシャルのマクロストラテジスト、ウィル・コンパーノール氏は「来週のＦＲＢの決定を左右するのはＰＰＩとＣＰＩになる」としている。

金利先物が織り込む来週のＦＯＭＣで利上げが決定される確率は約５９％。

この日はイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアのエネルギー施設を攻撃し、石油関連施設で火災が発生したことを受け、原油価格が約６週間ぶりの高値を更新。市場では、開始からすでに６カ月が経過している中東での戦闘が大幅に拡大するとの懸念が高まっている。

１０年債利回りはＦＲＢによる利上げの可能性などを背景に２０２３年１０月以来の高水準近辺で推移。ＦＨＮフィナンシャルのコンパーノール氏は「これまで見られた利回り上昇はファンダメンタルズにかなり沿っている」とし、「単に新たな常態を示しているだけである可能性があり、必ずしも何かがうまくいっていない兆候というわけではない」と述べた。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場は続落。セールスフォースなどソフトウエア株が売られ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種を圧迫した。市場では、週内に発表されるインフレ指標に注目が集まっている。

セールスフォースとインテュイットは約４％安、サービスナウは５％下落した。オープンＡＩが先週、最新モデル「ＧＰＴ─６ Ａｓｔｒａ（アストラ）」を発表したことで、人工知能（ＡＩ）が専門ソフトウエア企業の提供サービスと競合し得るとの観測が再燃した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種ソフトウエア・サービス株指数は１．４％安と、２日続落した。

アージェント・キャピタル・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、ジェド・エラーブローク氏は「アストラはソフトウエア業界の破壊的変化への懸念を再燃させた。半導体株やデータセンター向け設備投資の恩恵を受ける銘柄が好調な半面、ソフトウエア株が振るわないという、しばらく続いていた古いトレンドを再開させた」と述べた。

半導体大手インテルは９％急伸、クアルコムは３．２％上昇した。クアルコムは８日、アマゾン・ドット・コムに対し、長期的な提携の下で最大６００億ドル相当のＡＩデータセンター向け半導体および関連製品を供給する可能性があると発表した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 金相場は下落した。原油価格の上昇を受けてインフレ懸念が強まり、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が９月に利上げを実施するとの見方が広がった。投資家は、金融政策の先行きに関する一段の手掛かりを得ようと、週内に発表される米国のインフレ指標に注目している。

１８２２ＧＭＴ（日本時間９日午前３時２２分）時点で、スポット金は０．４％安の１オンス＝４３８５．０９ドル。米金先物（１２月限）の清算値は１％安の４４３０．１０ドル。

ストーンＸのシニアマーケットストラテジスト、ダニエル・パビロニス氏は「利上げの可能性が高まっていることから、金は上値が抑えられ、相場の勢いが鈍っている」と指摘した。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は上昇し、６週間ぶりの高値を付けた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアのエネルギー関連施設を攻撃し、石油関連施設で火災が発生。中東紛争が大幅に拡大する懸念が強まった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．９２ドル（０．９％）高の１バレル＝９７．９２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物が１．５５ドル（１．７％）高の９３．０３ドル。

両指標はテクニカル的に買われ過ぎ圏にとどまり、北海ブレントは２営業日連続で７月２３日以来の高値、米ＷＴＩは６月４日以来の高値で終えた。

item.title: Rays place SS Taylor Walls (hip) on 10-day injured list
item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays placed shortstop Taylor Walls on the 10-day injured list on Tuesday due to a right hip flexor strain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Tampa Bay Rays placed shortstop Taylor Walls on the 10-day injured list on Tuesday due to a right hip flexor strain. The move was retroactive to Sunday. In corresponding moves, the Rays recalled veteran infielder Nick Madrigal from Triple-A Durham and designated right-handed reliever Hunter Bigge for assignment to make room for Madrigal on the 40-man roster. Walls last played on Saturday, going 0-for-2 with a walk and his major league-leading 12th sacrifice bunt of the season in a 6-3 victory in 10 innings over the host Texas Rangers. The 30-year-old is batting .218 with two home runs and 33 RBIs in 117 games, but he has only nine errors in 441 chances for a .980 fielding percentage in 985 2/3 innings. He leads the major leagues with 21 total fielding runs above average. He also has 21 steals in 24 attempts. Walls is a career .199 hitter with 24 home runs and 169 RBIs in 597 regular-season games since 2021. Madrigal, 29, signed as a free agent with Tampa Bay on June 25. He played in 15 games for the Los Angeles Angels this season, batting .273 (12-for-44) with two RBIs. Madrigal is a career .274 hitter with four homers and 79 RBIs in 300 regular-season games for the Chicago White Sox (2020-21), Chicago Cubs (2022-24) and Angels (2026). He was batting .318 with two homers and 16 RBIs in 47 games for Durham. Bigge, 28, was 1-1 with a 6.98 ERA, 14 walks and 14 strikeouts in 19 1/3 innings over 18 relief appearances for Tampa Bay earlier this season. He was 1-1 with two saves and a 6.14 ERA in 29 1/3 innings over 27 relief appearances with Durham when he was designated for assignment. Infielder Oliver Dunn, who was designated for assignment on Saturday, cleared outright waivers on Tuesday and accepted his assignment to Durham. Dunn, who turned 29 last Wednesday, was 1-for-11 (.091) in nine games this season for Tampa Bay. The Rays acquired Dunn from the White Sox on May 19 for left-hander Joe Rock, who was waived by Chicago and selected by the Athletics on Aug. 16. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cognition AI raises $2 billion at $48 billion valuation
item.description: AI coding startup Cognition AI said on Tuesday it had raised $2 billion in a Series E funding round at a valuation of $48 billion.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: AI coding startup Cognition AI said on Tuesday it had raised $2 billion in a Series E funding round at a valuation of $48 billion. Here are some details: The round was led by new investors Andreessen Horowitz and Accel, alongside existing backers Founders Fund, General Catalyst, and Avenir. Cognition's run-rate revenue has grown from $492 million to nearly $900 million since its last round in May, the firm said in a blog. The latest round nearly doubles Cognition's valuation from $26 billion in May, when it raised $1 billion. Interest in AI-focused companies has surged significantly, as investors drawn by the lure of a technological revolution pour billions into the ecosystem. Cognition is an AI startup that develops autonomous software-engineering agents, which can plan, write, test and deploy code with limited human intervention.

item.title: Smithfield Foods expects to swing to third-quarter operating loss in fresh pork business
item.description: Smithfield Foods said on Tuesday its fresh pork segment is expected to swing to an adjusted operating loss in the third quarter, due to persistent pressure from lower hog prices and a shrinking industry market spread amid cautious spending.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Smithfield Foods (SFD.O) said on Tuesday its fresh pork segment is expected to swing to an adjusted operating loss in the third quarter, due to persistent pressure from lower hog prices and a shrinking industry market spread amid cautious spending. Shares of Smithfield fell nearly 2% in extended trading after the company also forecast lower current-quarter adjusted operating profit at its hog production business from a year ago. Here are some details: Smithfield said the falling USDA pork cutout and hog prices have squeezed industry margins, prompting a more "conservative view of segment profitability". "The change in our outlook is driven by external market conditions within portions of the pork value chain," said CEO Shane Smith. The U.S. pork processor now expects to report a third-quarter adjusted operating loss in the range of $70 million to $90 million in fresh pork segment, second largest revenue generator, after posting a profit of $10 million a year ago. It also forecast quarterly adjusted operating profit in hog production business between $25 million and $45 million, compared with $89 million a year earlier. However, it kept intact the fiscal 2026 adjusted operating income forecast for packaged meats - the company's largest segment, at between $1.08 billion and $1.15 billion. It also expects to report total company adjusted operating income for three months ending September in the range of $115 million to $175 million versus $310 million in the same period last year. The company, which has been navigating a cautious consumer spending environment, also said it was "disappointed" in how the commodity market dynamics would impact its near-term results. Last month, Smithfield cut its annual total sales and adjusted operating profit forecasts. It is expected to participate in the Barclays Global Consumer Conference on Thursday.

item.title: 米国、イラン航空部門に追加制裁－36対象を指定も効果に疑問
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国は8日、イランの航空部門を支援する企業などに対する措置を発表した。トランプ政権による新たな制裁措置の一環だが、こうした措置はイランの主要貿易相手国にさほど大きな影響を与えていないとみられる。

米財務省外国資産管理局（OFAC）は複数のイラン航空会社を特定国民・資産凍結対象者（SDN）リストに追加したほか、トルコやアラブ首長国連邦（UAE）などで、イランのマーハーン航空を支援してきた企業を制裁対象とした。マーハーン航空は中東や中国への運航を続けている。

財務省は声明で、「イランの航空部門を支援した」として、企業や個人など計36の対象を制裁対象にしたと発表した。イラン政権が武器や人員、不正な貨物の輸送に航空部門を利用していると指摘した。

さらに、「イランが米国製航空機や機密技術を入手するために利用している、実態を隠すための企業や海外の仲介業者、偽装した積み替えルート」を問題視した。この中には、最近、UAEとオマーンを経由して迂回（うかい）輸送された少なくとも3機のボーイング777型機も含まれるという。

財務省の金融犯罪取り締まりネットワーク（FinCEN）も、イランの航空部門との取引に伴うリスクについて金融機関に注意喚起した。イランによる弾道ミサイルやドローン（無人機）の部品調達を航空部門が支援しているとした。

財務省は先週、イランとの関係が疑われるとして、資本金が約3400万ドル（約52億円）に過ぎないトルコの小規模な投資銀行を制裁対象に指定した。同行は関係を否定している。8月下旬には、エジプト2位の銀行バンク・ミスルのUAE支店を米金融システムから排除する措置を取った。

ベッセント米財務長官は発表文で、「これまで制裁対象となっていなかったイランの航空会社と取引するすべての者への警告だ。これらの航空会社はすべて、きょう制裁対象とした。世界の金融システムから締め出される恐れがある」と述べた。

item.title: Rams DT Aaron Donald staying in LA, out for Week 1
item.description: Defensive tackle Aaron Donald is not traveling to Australia with the Los Angeles Rams, who ruled him out for the regular-season opener on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Defensive tackle Aaron Donald is not traveling to Australia with the Los Angeles Rams, who ruled him out for the regular-season opener on Tuesday. Rams coach Sean McVay said offseason addition Myles Garrett, limited by knee swelling in recent weeks, will start and make his debut with the team on Thursday against the San Francisco 49ers. The Rams opted for a cautious approach with Donald, who last played in January 2024 in a wild-card loss at Detroit. His first full team practice with 11-on-11 drills was Sunday, and playing him even limited reps was never part of the Rams' plan, McVay said. "He's doing a great job," McVay said of Donald. "I think he'll be ready to go sooner rather than later, but we're making a decision that we think is best for him and for our team." A three-time NFL Defensive player of the Year, Donald worked on a side field after making his return official on Aug. 30. A Pro Bowl selection in all 10 of his seasons and a first-team All-Pro in eight, the 35-year-old admitted on Monday that he wasn't where he "wanted to be" physically but knows his current level of play is still "pretty damn good." Garrett, 30, led the NFL in sacks (23) to set the single-season record in 2025 before he was acquired from the Cleveland Browns. In the Rams' defensive scheme, Garrett will align at outside linebacker opposite Byron Young. Young had 12.0 sacks last season. "His impact has been tremendous," McVay said. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米国債買い戻し、ウォール街が規模を注視－40億ドルを上回るとの観測
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は、拡大される国債買い戻しプログラムを通じた米国債利回りの抑制に、当初どこまで踏み込む用意があるのかを明らかにする。ウォール街のディーラーは神経をとがらせている。

米財務省は9日、翌日に実施する残存期間10－20年の国債の買い戻し規模を発表する見通し。過去の例に従えば、発表は米東部時間午前11時（日本時間10日午前0時）となる。同省は8月19日、それまでのわずか2週間前に予定していた20億ドル（約3080億円）の買い戻し額を「少なくとも倍増」すると表明し、市場参加者を驚かせていた。今回がそれ以来初の発表となる。

ベッセント氏は9月10日の買い戻し規模について繰り返し明言を避けているが、公の場での発言を受け、多くの市場参加者の間では40億ドルを上回るとの観測が強まっている。同氏は8日、この取り組みについて、市場で「高まりつつあったこの熱」を冷ますことが狙いだと説明した。先月、長期債利回りを数年ぶりの高水準に押し上げた債券売りを指しているとみられる。

米住宅ローン金利の重要な指標となる10年債利回りが現在、先月の水準をさらに上回っているだけに、発表の重要性は高い。買い戻し額が40億ドルにとどまれば投資家の失望を招き、世界最大の債券市場で売り圧力が強まる可能性がある。

一方、巨額の買い戻しを選択すれば、2週間後に予定される次回以降の長期債買い戻しについて、新たな基準を設定することになり得る。モルガン・スタンレーは、実務上の上限を100億ドルと試算している。また、先月の予想外の動き以降、ベッセント氏の利回り水準への懸念がさらに深まったことを示唆する可能性もある。

ライトソンICAPのシニアエコノミスト、ルー・クランドール氏は顧客向けリポートで、買い戻し額の大幅な増加は「財務省が8月19日の性急な発表について、そもそも十分に検討していなかったことを認めることになる」と指摘した。

item.title: Preço do trigo sobe após esforços dos EUA para pôr fim à guerra na Ucrânia apresentarem poucos avanços
item.description: Os futuros do trigo em Chicago saltaram nesta terça-feira, depois que uma iniciativa diplomática dos EUA para pôr fim à guerra de quatro anos na Ucrânia — que tem prejudicado os embarques de grãos do Mar Negro — não surtiu grande efeito no fim de semana.
item.dc:creator: Heather Schlitz
item.content:encoded: Os futuros do trigo em Chicago saltaram nesta terça-feira, depois que uma iniciativa diplomática dos EUA para pôr fim à guerra de quatro anos na Ucrânia — que tem prejudicado os embarques de grãos do Mar Negro — não surtiu grande efeito no fim de semana. Os futuros de milho e soja oscilaram para cima e para baixo, à medida que os operadores ajustavam suas posições antes do relatório de oferta e demanda do Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA, a ser divulgado na sexta-feira. O contrato de trigo mais negociado na Bolsa de Chicago <Wv1> fechou com alta de 13 centavos, a US$7,47 por bushel. Ele havia atingido uma máxima de US$7,63 nas negociações noturnas anteriores. O milho da CBOT fechou com queda de 3,25 centavos, a US$5,3350 por bushel, enquanto a soja fechou com alta de 6,50 centavos, a US$13,1625 por bushel. “Os enviados de Trump viajaram no fim de semana e não voltaram com nada concreto”, disse Jim Gerlach, presidente da A/C Trading. Os enviados de paz dos EUA, Jared Kushner e Steve Witkoff, se reuniram com o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, em Moscou, e com o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, em Kiev, no fim de semana, mas seus esforços diplomáticos não pareceram garantir um avanço decisivo para o fim da guerra que permitisse a retomada em grande escala das exportações de grãos da Ucrânia e da Rússia, segundo os operadores. Zelenskiy disse nesta terça-feira que os negociadores de paz dos EUA haviam apresentado várias “ideias decentes” durante as conversas. Os ataques recíprocos da Rússia e da Ucrânia aos portos e à navegação um do outro praticamente paralisaram as exportações dos países pelo Mar Negro, levando os compradores a buscar alternativas. A desorganização nas exportações de grãos do Mar Negro levou os importadores asiáticos de trigo a comprar pelo menos meio milhão de toneladas de trigo australiano e argentino em negócios recentes, segundo fontes do setor na semana passada. A Ucrânia quase concluiu sua colheita de trigo de 2026, produzindo 24,91 milhões de toneladas do grão com um rendimento médio de 4,94 toneladas por hectare, informou o Ministério da Agricultura nesta terça-feira. A soja tem sido sustentada pelas compras chinesas de soja dos EUA e pelas preocupações com o clima quente e seco nas principais regiões produtoras dos EUA. As importações chinesas de soja totalizaram 74,11 milhões de toneladas no período de janeiro a agosto, um aumento de 1,1% em relação às 73,33 milhões de toneladas do ano anterior, segundo dados divulgados nesta terça-feira pela Administração Geral das Alfândegas do país. As importações do maior comprador mundial de soja caíram 1,1% em agosto em relação ao ano anterior, para 12,14 milhões de toneladas, segundo os dados. O Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA informou na semana passada que os exportadores venderam 192 mil toneladas de soja à China para entrega na safra 2026/27. As expectativas de baixos rendimentos no Cinturão do Milho dos EUA têm mantido um piso para os futuros de milho. Os mercados de grãos também estão voltando sua atenção para as previsões mensais de oferta e demanda do Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA, previstas para sexta-feira.

item.title: US Supreme Court won't reinstate Republican-drawn congressional map in Missouri
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court declined on Tuesday to reinstate a Republican-drawn congressional map in Missouri ahead of November's midterm elections, dealing a setback to President Donald Trump and the party's odds of maintaining its slim majority in the House of Representatives.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chung
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Supreme Court declined on Tuesday to reinstate a Republican-drawn congressional map in Missouri ahead of November's midterm elections, dealing a setback to President Donald Trump and the party's odds of maintaining its slim majority in the House of Representatives. Conservative Justice Brett Kavanaugh denied Missouri's emergency request to suspend a state Supreme Court ruling that [USN:L1N44V11Z TEXT:"blocked the map"], a decision that preserves the Kansas City-based seat of longtime Democratic Representative Emanuel Cleaver, whose district would have been dismantled under the redrawn boundaries. Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from Missouri and several other states, did not refer the matter to the nine-member court before issuing the decision. Missouri Republicans adopted the map as part of a broader effort backed by Trump to redraw congressional districts in ways that could benefit Republican candidates. The seven-member Missouri Supreme Court, which includes five Republican-appointed judges, unanimously ruled on September 3 that the Republican-drawn map must be approved by voters in a November referendum before it can take effect. Republicans hold a narrow 219-214 majority in the U.S. House, including one independent who caucuses with Republicans. While both Republican- and Democratic-controlled states drew new maps as part of an unprecedented mid-decade redistricting war, Republicans eventually [USN:L1N4250NA TEXT:"emerged as the winners"]. Republicans improved their chances in 16 districts, including Cleaver's seat in Missouri, while Democrats secured an edge in six districts. The effort [USN:L1N41A0JW TEXT:"repeatedly"] [USN:S0N3WN09U TEXT:"drew"] the U.S. Supreme Court into disputes over congressional redistricting. A major Supreme Court ruling [USN:S0N3YR00L TEXT:"limiting the reach"] of the landmark Voting Rights Act and subsequent [USN:S0N40I0AH TEXT:"actions"] by the court permitted several conservative Southern states to eliminate districts with significant Black populations. The challenge in Missouri began after a group formed to oppose the new map, People Not Politicians, had collected enough signatures to file for a referendum under a provision in the state constitution that authorizes a ballot measure to approve any legislative act. Missouri's Republican Secretary of State Denny Hoskins, the state's top election official, rejected the petition, finding that state constitutional language does not apply to congressional redistricting. The Missouri court dismissed that argument. "The referendum petition was legal, sufficient, and timely, and the secretary incorrectly concluded otherwise," Judge Ginger Gooch wrote for the court. The redrawn map "will not go into effect unless and until approved by voters," Gooch said. Missouri's Republican Attorney General Catherine Hanaway's office told the U.S. Supreme Court that the decision forces Missouri to revert to an older electoral map in November's elections even though the state had already held primary elections in August using the new map.

item.title: Messi nears deal to acquire Spanish second-tier club Eldense
item.description: Lionel Messi is close to completing a deal to buy Spanish second-tier club CD Eldense, adding to his growing portfolio of football ownership interests, according to multiple reports in Spain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lionel Messi is close to completing a deal to buy Spanish second-tier club CD Eldense, adding to his growing portfolio of football ownership interests, according to multiple reports in Spain. Messi has agreed in principle to acquire all the shares held by majority owner TH Soluciones Group S.A.S., with an announcement expected in the coming days, the reports said. The Colombian investment group, which took control of Eldense in October, 2025, would transfer its entire stake to Messi. The deal remains subject to the approval of Spain's High Council for Sports (CSD). Reuters has contacted TH Soluciones and Eldense for comment. Messi, who [USN:S0N42V055 TEXT:"recently retired"] from international duty with Argentina, acquired fifth-tier Spanish side[USN:L6N40Z149 TEXT:" UE Cornella"] on April 16. He is also due to receive a stake in [USN:L6N44X05X TEXT:"Major League Soccer club Inter Miami"], once his playing contract with the team ends. Eldense are based in Elda, a town of about 55,000 people in the eastern Spanish province of Alicante. The club have spent most of their history in Spain's lower divisions but, following fresh investment, have played in the second tier in three of the past four seasons. Eldense sacked manager Claudio Barragan on Sunday after taking two points from their opening four league matches, leaving them third from bottom.

item.title: Trump administration cuts criticism of Confederate statue that stood at Arlington Cemetery
item.description: President Donald Trump's administration has removed language that criticized a memorial to the Confederacy that previously stood at Arlington National Cemetery, according to archived versions of its web page.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump 's administration has removed language that criticized a memorial to the Confederacy that previously stood at Arlington National Cemetery, according to archived versions of its web page. Among the removals was a line that said "the elaborately designed monument offers a nostalgic, mythologized vision of the Confederacy, including highly sanitized depictions of slavery." The Confederate Memorial was a 32-foot bronze statue unveiled in 1914 and removed from the military cemetery in 2023. The memorial [USN:L8N3DF023 TEXT:"was among"] scores of statues erected decades after the U.S. Civil War, during the late 19th and early 20th centuries when Southern states imposed segregation laws. Historians have said the memorials were tied to efforts to promote the "Lost Cause" narrative of the Confederacy and were seen by many as monuments to racism. Many were singled out for demolition by state and local leaders around the U.S. after a nationwide public uproar stirred in 2020 by the killing of George Floyd. Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth said last year the statue would be reinstalled at Arlington National Cemetery and criticized its removal in the first place that he attributed to a "woke" outlook. Since returning to the White House, Trump has [USN:L4N3YU0BK TEXT:"targeted"] U.S. cultural and historical institutions -- from museums to monuments to national parks -- in what critics say is part of a larger campaign to present U.S. history from a conservative view. Historians and civil rights advocates say such steps risk reversing [USN:FWN3UB0D2 TEXT:"social progress"], and [USN:L4N3YE20A TEXT:"undermine the acknowledgement"] of critical phases of U.S. history. Trump says he is combating what he calls "[USN:FWN3QA1DL TEXT:"anti-American ideology"]." Congress formally mandated elimination of all names, symbols and statues commemorating the Confederacy throughout the U.S. military in 2021, creating a commission to oversee the endeavor. The monument features a classically robed woman cast in bronze representing the American South standing atop a three-story pedestal adorned with life-sized figures of deities, Confederate soldiers and civilians. Among those figures are an enslaved African American "mammy" character holding the infant child of a white Confederate officer, and an enslaved African American man following his owner off to war.

Exclusive-US resumes immigrant visa processing for Hungary, Poland as pause remains elsewhere

By Humeyra Pamuk, Kristina Cooke and Jonathan Landay WASHINGTON, Sept 8 (Reuters) – President Donald Trump’s administration resumed processing immigrant visa applications from Hungary and Poland last week while maintaining a temporary pause on immigrant visa appointments elsewhere, four people familiar with the matter said.

The directive to prioritize immigrant visas at the U.S. missions in Poland and Hungary came from the White House, two of the sources said. While it was not immediately clear why the U.S. singled out the two countries for special attention, Trump and his senior aides have cultivated far-right allies in both places.

He publicly endorsed former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban, who was defeated at the polls in April, and Poland’s nationalist President Karol Nawrocki, whose election has put him at odds with the centrist government of Prime Minister Donald Tusk.

Show Full Article

In May, Reuters reported that U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau instructed senior State Department officials to facilitate a U.S. visa for a fugitive former Polish cabinet minister who had taken refuge from corruption charges in Hungary.

The White House referred a request for comment to the State Department. A State Department spokesperson did not comment on why it resumed immigrant visa processing for Hungary and Poland.

The Hungarian Foreign Ministry and Prime Minister’s Office, as well as the Polish Foreign Ministry, and prime minister’s and president’s offices did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

TRUMP TARGETS BOTH ILLEGAL AND LEGAL MIGRATION

Trump has long campaigned on stopping illegal immigration, but his second term has been defined in equal measure by his expansive efforts to curb legal migration. The U.S. has imposed travel bans on dozens of countries, introduced expensive new fees for certain work visas and mandated that all applicants undergo a vetting of their social media history.

In January, the State Department said it was temporarily suspending the processing of immigrant visas — which allow people to move permanently to the United States — in 75 countries where applicants were “at a high risk for becoming a public charge.”

After a federal judge ruled against the visa ban, the State Department paused immigrant visa interviews at all of its global missions while rolling out a new training program.

The State Department spokesperson, speaking on the condition of anonymity, said appointments were being adjusted to accommodate the new training. “Whenever there are updated instructions for visa applicants or changes to visa interview appointments, embassies and consulates communicate this information directly to visa applicants,” they wrote.

GLOBAL IMPACT

U.S. consulates and embassies traditionally conduct hundreds of thousands of immigrant visa interviews every year, most of them with relatives of U.S. citizens or permanent residents. In 2024, the last year of Joe Biden’s Democratic presidency, the U.S. issued some 600,000 immigrant visas.

The State Department’s January edict was its most far-reaching attempt to rein in legal migration. The visa suspension affected applicants from Latin American countries including Brazil, Colombia, and Uruguay; Balkan nations such as Bosnia and Albania; and South Asian countries Pakistan and Bangladesh.

On August 21, however, U.S. District Judge Jeannette A. Vargas struck down the policy as “patently unlawful.”

In the days that followed, the State Department called missions around the world and told them to cancel immigrant visa appointments, according to two people with knowledge of the situation.

The State Department acknowledged the global pause in a public statement on August 25, saying it would remain in place until staffers received new training in how to assess whether visa applicants could support themselves in the United States without relying on public benefits.

The U.S. government said in a court filing that interviews were temporarily rescheduled through August 31.

But the suspension could remain in place for months due to the structure of the new training program. Missions need to self-train based on materials sent from Washington; a consular officer then needs to visit each post to certify that the training has been completed, a person familiar with the matter said.

On a Reddit thread, people from around the world, including Peru, the United Kingdom and India, posted about canceled visa appointments through September.

“We were at the finish line and now this,” one person wrote.

(Reporting by Humeyra Pamuk and Jonathan Landay in Washington and Kristina Cooke in San Francisco; Additional reporting by Gergely Szakacs in Budapest and Alan Charlish in Warsaw; Editing by Jesse Mesner-Hage and Rod Nickel )

item.content:encoded: A horse stands inside a corral on rancher Ricardo Ramirez's property in Zapata, Texas, U.S., August 19, 2026. Ranchers in Texas are monitoring the spread of New World screwworm following the parasite's return to the United States. REUTERS/Daniel BecerrilDANIEL BECERRILReuters

item.title: ウクライナ、パトリオットミサイル約1000発調達へ 同盟国の支援活用＝国防相
item.description: [キーウ ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ　８日　ロイター] - ウクライナのフメラ国防相は８日、同盟国の支援と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の融資を活用し、米国が設計した地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」用ミサイル約１０００発の調達契約を結ぶ方針を明らかにした。

ウクライナ国防コンタクトグループ（ＵＤＣＧ、通称ラムシュタイン・グループ）の会合でフメラ氏は、大部分のミサイルの引き渡しは数年先になるとし、より緊急性の高い支援を呼びかけた。

また、国防省が公表したコメントの中でフメラ氏は、西側パートナー国に対し、ウクライナと締結した契約に基づくミサイル性能の向上と引き換えに、各国の備蓄からより多くの防空ミサイルを提供するよう要請していると説明。ウクライナは、２７０億ドル分のドローン（無人機）の調達資金不足に苦しんでいると述べた。

北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のルッテ事務総長は会合で、ウクライナが「現在、あらゆる戦線で生み出している好機を捉え、空域で自国を防衛できるよう」、ウクライナの同盟国は支援を強化する以外に選択肢 はないと強調した。

item.title: Paramount says California AG contradicted bond arguments in TV interviews
item.description: Paramount Skydance said on Tuesday that California Attorney General Rob Bonta made statements in television interviews that undermine his legal arguments against the company's request for a $1.88 billion bond in the Warner Bros. Discovery merger case.
item.dc:creator: Jody Godoy
item.content:encoded: Paramount Skydance (PSKY.O) said on Tuesday that California Attorney General Rob Bonta made statements in television interviews that undermine his legal arguments against the company's request for a $1.88 billion bond in the Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD.O) merger case. Paramount is looking to insulate itself against the cost of delaying its bid to become a major rival of Netflix (NFLX.O) and Disney (DIS.N) , as California and others seek to block the deal as illegal. Paramount has said a bond is necessary so the company can recover losses if it wins cases brought by a California-led group of states and the Writers Guild of America. By the time the case is scheduled to conclude in April, Paramount has said it will have paid Warner Bros shareholders $1.3 billion in fees. One of Bonta's legal arguments against the bond is that Paramount voluntarily agreed to pause closing the deal, rather than wait for a judge to issue an injunction pausing the transaction. But Bonta has described the pause as equivalent to an injunction in television interviews, Paramount said on Tuesday, arguing that antitrust law requires the states to post a bond. Bonta's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. U.S. District Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguin in Oakland has scheduled a hearing on Paramount's bond request for September 24. California and 11 other states sued to block the deal in July, saying it would create a media behemoth with the power to raise prices in film and television. The Writers Guild of America has also sued, saying it would worsen working conditions and pay for writers. Paramount has said the deal will strengthen the film and TV industry and lead to more, rather than less, content. While Paramount and Bonta have both said they are willing to negotiate, Bonta has said the states are ready to go to trial if a potential settlement does not address their concerns.

item.title: Sabalenka happy to trade top ranking for US Open 'three-peat'
item.description: Sabalenka said completing a third consecutive U.S. Open triumph would ease any disappointment if she surrenders the world number one ranking, with the Belarusian's fate at the top of the ladder no longer entirely in her own hands.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Sabalenka said completing a third consecutive U.S. Open triumph would ease any disappointment if she surrenders the world number one ranking, with the Belarusian's fate at the top of the ladder no longer entirely in her own hands. Sabalenka took a big step towards joining rare company on Tuesday, beating Linda Noskova 7-6(1) 3-6 7-6(10-7) to reach the semi-finals and stay on course for a New York "three-peat" not witnessed since Serena Williams's triumphs from 2012-14. The prospect of a third straight title holds greater appeal for Sabalenka than keeping top spot in the rankings, with Elena Rybakina able to overtake her if she gets a quarter-final win over China's Zheng Qinwen on Wednesday. "Yes, I'll be more than happy. A 'three-peat' sounds great," Sabalenka told reporters. "I'm just super happy that I've put myself in the position where I have a chance to go for three-peat, even though I'm still far away from that." Sabalenka knows the pitfalls of chasing a third straight title at the same Grand Slam, having fallen to American Madison Keys in the 2025 Australian Open final after utterly dominant triumphs in the previous two years. "What I learned from Australia is it's really important to shut down all of the noise and having that at the back of your mind," Sabalenka added. "Nothing wrong about that, just as long as you're focusing on yourself, as long as you're ready to fight, basically." Should results go their way, Sabalenka and Rybakina would meet in Saturday's final, renewing a rivalry that has already produced memorable showdowns on the sport's biggest stages, including at this year's Australian Open final.

item.title: German foreign minister says Kyiv should buy more arms from German companies
item.description: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul told Bild newspaper on Tuesday that Ukraine should buy more weapons from German companies, saying Berlin's position as Kyiv's biggest donor meant it had the right to expect orders for its defence companies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul told Bild newspaper on Tuesday that Ukraine should buy more weapons from German companies, saying Berlin's position as Kyiv's biggest donor meant it had the right to expect orders for its defence companies. Wadephul said he had assured Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy during a visit last month that Germany would continue to support Ukraine in its defence against Russia . "But I also have to explain this to German taxpayers, and the very least you can do is to ensure that the German defence industry is involved in all procurement activities," the newspaper quoted him as saying. "At the moment, we're not entirely satisfied with the level of orders we're receiving in Germany," he said. Wadephul's comments came days after Germany accused Russia of being behind an attempted drone attack on Leipzig/Halle airport in August that authorities said only just missed causing a major disaster. The accusation, denied by Russia, has added to tensions between Moscow and Berlin, which ordered the closure of the Russian consulate in Bonn and a Russian cultural centre in Berlin in response. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov was quoted by the state news agency TASS as saying the German accusations were "by and large, the [USN:S8N40Z051 TEXT:"start of a real war"]." Wadephul dismissed Lavrov's comments and said Germany had no choice but to respond to the incident. "We had to react. He knows that; it's clear to everyone," he said. Wadephul also said that Ukrainian men of military age who were currently in Germany should return home, and he said Berlin could help the Ukrainian government identify them. "We do, after all, know who lives here, who, for example, receives social security benefits or who is registered here, and who has residence status," he said.

item.title: Sunderland beat Hull City 1-0 to reach League Cup last 16
item.description: Morocco international Chemsdine Talbi made the difference as Sunderland beat Premier League rivals Hull City 1-0 at the Stadium of Light to reach the last 16 of the League Cup on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Morocco international Chemsdine Talbi made the difference as Sunderland beat Premier League rivals Hull City 1-0 at the Stadium of Light to reach the last 16 of the League Cup on Tuesday. Talbi chipped goalkeeper Dillon Phillips in the 71st minute in the only match of the evening between two top-flight sides fielding much changed lineups from their weekend league fixtures. Crystal Palace beat Championship side Middlesbrough 3-0 in South London while Bournemouth went one better at the Vitality Stadium and saw off second-tier opponents Lincoln City 4-0 with Ryan Christie scoring a hat-trick in their first competitive win under new manager Marco Rose. Jorgen Strand Larsen scored headers in each half for Crystal Palace with Daichi Kamada completing the scoring in the 72nd. Newcastle United, the 2025 winners, left it late against second-tier Millwall in their third-round match but went through 1-0 thanks to a deflected Joe Willock effort in the 81st minute at The Den. Chelsea are at home to Leeds United on Wednesday with the remaining fixtures scheduled for next week.

item.title: Blackstone explores sale of ZO Skin Health, sources say
item.description: Investment firm Blackstone is looking to sell medical-grade skincare company ZO Skin Health, which could be valued at around $2 billion in any deal, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Abigail Summerville
item.content:encoded: Investment firm Blackstone (BX.N) is looking to sell medical-grade skincare company ZO Skin Health, which could be valued at around $2 billion in any deal, according to people familiar with the matter. The firm is working with investment bankers at Citigroup (C.N) and Raymond James (RJF.N) on the sale, which is at an early stage, the people said, requesting anonymity because the matter is private. Blackstone and Citi declined to comment. ZO and Raymond James did not immediately respond to comment requests. Dermatologist Dr. Zein Obagi founded the brand in 2007. ZO sells skincare products including cleansers, serums, exfoliators, and toners that are distributed by physicians and skincare professionals. The sale process comes at a time when many strategic buyers are prioritizing clinically backed, physician-distributed skincare brands like ZO, because of their efficacy and steadier demand versus over-the-counter products.

item.title: Presidente do STF se diz "plenamente convencido" de que Judiciário está à altura dos desafios no momento
item.description: O presidente do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), Edson Fachin, disse nesta terça-feira estar convencido de que o Judiciário está à altura dos desafios que se colocam e afirmou que o contexto atual pede "diálogo permanente".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), Edson Fachin, disse nesta terça-feira estar convencido de que o Judiciário está à altura dos desafios que se colocam e afirmou que o contexto atual pede "diálogo permanente". "Estou plenamente convencido de que o Poder Judiciário brasileiro está à altura dos desafios que se lhe apresentam no momento contemporâneo", disse o presidente do STF. As declarações de Fachin foram dadas em evento do Conselho Nacional de Justiça com o colégio de corregedores e corregedoras da Justiça do Brasil e não fizeram referência direta a qualquer tema específico, mas ocorre em meio à crise institucional instalada no Supremo envolvendo os ministros Alexandre de Moraes e André Mendonça. A mais grave crise no STF foi deflagrada após Mendonça tornar público um relatório da Polícia Federal no âmbito das investigações do Banco Master indicando mensagens entre o banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro e um contato identificado como sendo Alexandre de Moraes, levantando dúvidas sobre a natureza de eventual relação entre os dois e sobre a atuação do ministro. Dois dias depois, Moraes pediu uma apuração sobre a conduta de Mendonça, acusando-o de atuar de forma irregular. Para Moraes, o colega teria ultrapassado os limites de sua função como juiz e passado a atuar como dirigente da investigação. Também aponta irregularidades no manejo das provas colhidas no caso, o que poderia levar, em última instância, à nulidade do processo. Para sustentar tais afirmações, Moraes utilizou relatório interno da área de inteligência da PF. Mendonça questiona sua utilização. Nesta terça-feira, por sua vez, Mendonça determinou o afastamento do diretor-geral da PF, Andrei Rodrigues, intensificando ainda mais a crise instalada.

item.title: イラン革命防衛隊、米攻撃への報復警告 クウェート・バーレーンの船舶標的
item.description: [ドバイ ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ　８日 ロイター] - イラン軍事精鋭部隊の革命防衛隊は現地時間９日未明、米国によるイランの原油タンカーへの攻撃への報復として、米軍が駐留するクウェートとバーレーンの港湾に停泊している船舶を攻撃の標的にすると表明した。

イラン国営メディアが伝えた声明によると、革命防衛隊海軍は全ての乗組員に対し、船舶から退避するよう警告している。

これに先立ちイランのタスニム通信は、同国南部カーグ島の約６．４キロの沖合で、小型のイラン籍タンカーが米軍のミサイル攻撃を受けたと報道。地元関係者の話として、タンカーはカーグ島の停泊地付近で米軍が発射した飛翔体による攻撃を受けたと報じた。死傷者は確認されておらず、乗組員の避難が進められているとしていた。

カーグ島はペルシャ湾に位置する島で、イラン最大の原油積み出し拠点がある。
